markets.question: Game 2: Both Teams Slay a Dragon?
markets.description:
This market is about whether both teams slay at least one elemental dragon during Game 2. In League of Legends, elemental dragons (Infernal, Mountain, Ocean, Hextech, Chemtech, and Cloud) spawn in the dragon pit starting at 5:00 game time. After being slain, the next dragon spawns 5 minutes later. Once a team claims the Dragon Soul (by slaying four dragons), all subsequent dragon spawns become Elder Dragons.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if both LYON and JD Gaming each slay at least one elemental dragon during Game 2. This market will resolve to "No" if either team (or both teams) does not slay any elemental dragon during Game 2. Only elemental dragons count toward this market — Elder Dragon kills do not count.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 2 is never played due to forfeit, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 2 is not played because the series result has already been determined (e.g., a team clinches the series before Game 2 is needed), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 2 begins but is not completed and ends via surrender, this market will resolve based on whether both teams had slain at least one elemental dragon prior to stoppage. If the condition was not met, this market will resolve to "No".

eventMetadata.context_description: Tennessee Volunteers' overwhelming talent edge over Miami (OH) RedHawks, as an SEC powerhouse facing a MAC champion, anchors the 82.5% implied probability for a Vols victory in the Music City Bowl. Despite significant opt-outs—including leading rusher Dylan Sampson (1,491 yards) and top receiver Squirrel White—Tennessee's depth from a 10-3 season and recent College Football Playoff experience against Ohio State provides a clear advantage. Miami enters hot at 11-2 after 10 straight wins and a MAC title-clinching victory over Toledo, boasting stout defense led by QB Brett Gabbert, but historical SEC-MAC bowl mismatches and Tennessee's home-state motivation in Nashville sustain trader consensus on a comfortable Vols win.

eventMetadata.context_description: Timberwolves' six-game win streak and Portland's mounting injuries anchor the 72% implied probability favoring Minnesota, reflecting trader consensus on the Wolves' defensive dominance and offensive firepower led by Anthony Edwards. The Trail Blazers, mired in a five-game skid with a 2-8 record, face a setback without Jerami Grant (out, knee) and Deandre Ayton (questionable, illness), crippling their frontcourt rebounding against Minnesota's elite paint protection. Head-to-head, the Wolves have won seven of the last 10 meetings, bolstered by home-court edge and fresher legs off two days' rest versus Portland's back-to-back fatigue. While upsets occur, recent form and roster health heavily tilt market sentiment toward Minnesota.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket prices California Governor Gavin Newsom as the frontrunner at 24.9% for the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination, reflecting his national profile from high-visibility clashes with Republican leaders and strong fundraising in a post-2024 field lacking a clear heir apparent after Kamala Harris's defeat. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez trails at 8.3%, buoyed by progressive grassroots energy but limited by polarizing appeal, while Jon Ossoff's 7.0% stems from his youth and Georgia Senate incumbency signaling swing-state viability. Harris lingers at 5.1% amid questions over her electability. Key differentiators include executive experience for Newsom, ideological purity for Ocasio-Cortez, and battleground credentials for Ossoff; consolidation could hinge on 2026 midterm results, early fundraising tallies, and endorsements from party elders.

eventMetadata.context_description: New York Knicks hold an 88.5% implied probability as heavy favorites against the Brooklyn Nets, driven primarily by their superior recent form and healthier lineup. In contrast, the Nets sit at 1-6, hampered by Nic Claxton's extended knee absence and Cam Thomas' questionable status with a back issue, weakening their defense and scoring. Knicks also own a 4-1 edge in recent head-to-heads, amplified by home-court advantage at Madison Square Garden, where they shoot 48% from the field. Trader consensus reflects these roster and momentum edges, though Nets' desperation could spark an upset.

eventMetadata.context_description: Detroit Pistons' 75.5% implied probability reflects trader consensus on Golden State Warriors' depleted roster amid a brutal injury wave, with Stephen Curry sidelined by a deep thigh bruise, Jonathan Kuminga out with thigh soreness, and Buddy Hield questionable with an ankle tweak per official reports. Pistons ride a hot streak, winners of four straight behind Cade Cunningham's explosive 29.5 points per game average and top-10 defense clamping opponents to 98 points nightly. Warriors limp in at 1-4 road form, outscored by 12 per 100 possessions without Curry, while Detroit's athletic frontcourt exploits Golden State's thin wing depth in this key Eastern Conference tilt. Upsets remain possible given NBA volatility.

This market will resolve to “Yes” if the named individual wins and accepts the 2028 nomination of the Republican Party for U.S. president. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

The resolution source for this market will be a consensus of official Republican Party sources.

Any replacement of the Republican nominee before election day will not change the resolution of the market.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket positions Robert F. Kennedy Jr. as the frontrunner for the 2028 Republican presidential nomination at 49%, driven by his October 2024 endorsement of Donald Trump, high visibility in populist health policy debates, and appeal to anti-establishment GOP voters despite his independent background. J.D. Vance follows at 37.1%, bolstered by his vice presidential election and status as Trump's heir apparent after the 2024 victory imposed term limits. Marco Rubio's 28.1% reflects his Senate Foreign Relations chairmanship and rumored cabinet roles like Secretary of State. Recent Trump transition announcements have elevated Vance and Rubio's profiles, while RFK Jr.'s sustained media presence sustains trader optimism, though early odds signal high uncertainty ahead of primaries.

title: 2026 FIFA World Cup Winner
description:
This market will resolve according to the national team that wins the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

If at any point it becomes impossible for this team to win the FIFA World Cup based on the rules of FIFA (e.g., they are eliminated in the knockout stage), this market will resolve immediately to “No”.

If the 2026 FIFA World Cup is permanently canceled or has not been completed by October 13, 2026, 11:59 PM this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source will be official information from FIFA, however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
